about: Which id of docs/design/detailed_mechanics.json each literal of the code's content enumerations is. Kept by hand; read by tools/mechanics_check.py, which fails when a literal here is gone, a new one is not here, or an id here is gone from the document. A target is an id of the enumeration's own section, or 'section:id'; a list where one literal is several things; null where the build has a thing the document does not (say why in notes). A leading '~' marks a thing the generator makes in the world and nothing in the colony uses yet. The mapping is Claude's reading (2026-11-22), not John's ruling: docs/design/Mechanics_crosswalk.md says where a reading could go either way.

notes.Forester: the document renamed the one who fells trees Woodcutter (its Forester is a noble who keeps the forest); the code, the logs and the interface still say forester
notes.Cook: a job the player gives in the build; in the document a peasant's job come to by skill (cooking 5), not an opening job

notes.Builder: the document's Wright, plain name Builder; in the build a forester's trade, in the document it rises from the woodcutter: the same
notes.As_Stockman: a porter's trade; in the document it rises from the stock hand or the porter
notes.As_Carpenter: a forester's trade; in the document it rises from the wright

notes.Carcass: a kill carried home to be butchered: never stored
notes.Sticks: an armful of dead wood for the fire: never stored
notes.Ladder: made at a stockpile for thatching a roof (John, 2026-11-12); the document has no ladder

notes.Camp_Zone: the camp with its fire; since 2026-11-20 the homestake and the campfire are one square (his word), which is the document's home stake

notes.Stockyard_Box: in the code the stockyard is a stockpile's zone with a flag (Zone_Rec.Yard)

notes.Floor: a place on the storehouse's floor
notes.Cover: a place under a covering in the yard (the document's open yard, tier 2: lean-tos)
notes.Lean: a ladder's place against the wall

notes.Hovel: the document's tier 1 of the serf's dwelling
notes.Storehouse: the document's stock-house; its fenced yard and coverings are the document's open yard, the ground before it the staging area (built_otherwise)

notes.Bog_Iron_Patch: bog iron in wet ground: the generator's; the document has iron in veins only

notes.Granite: the ground's rock: nothing quarries it (stone comes off boulders)
notes.Placer_Gravel: gold in river gravel: the generator's; no id
notes.Boulder: where the build's stone comes from: prised off by porters; the document's rock is cut by quarrymen in a quarry
notes.Rock_Salt: generated; the band's salt comes from the lord's cart, as the document has it until a vein is mined
notes.Plank: what a floor, a door or a fence is laid as: made of logs, no item of its own
notes.Shingle: a roof's material, not used by the hovel
notes.Daub: laid from straw at one rate with thatch; the document's tier with daub names clay
notes.Fieldstone: stone laid: a retaining wall, a stair, a step

built_otherwise.about: Ids of the document the build has a thing for that no enumeration above names.

numbers.what: the day of the year the game starts on, counted from 0 (the document's season and day of arrival, the first day of spring being day 0)

numbers.units_differ: the code counts pounds (his 60 lb of meat a deer, 2026-11-12), the document's quantities are placeholders

numbers.what: a berry bush grows back, days
